_comment: The effect type ends in THEN_DISCARD and made EACH HERO discard a card at random. This card's text says nothing about discarding -- it is purely "each hero who doesn't have a card in their arsenal puts the top card of their deck face down into their arsenal". A symmetric invented downside that hurt the caster too, so discard is off. The "who doesn't have a card in their arsenal" gate is the handler's own arsenal-limit check; the explicit `condition` spelling of it was redundant and is dropped.
